name: qthe-core
description: The qthe 8-bit substrate primitive: 2-bit timbre + 6-bit amplitude, 64-slot wormhole table, deterministic Moore-8 tick. The v0 API adds the journaled Substrate (op-log, snapshot/restore, replayable qth1: traces) alongside the byte-exact kernel (JS float + fixed planes), C99, and Python(L0).
